title: Choosing a family vacation package in BC
prompt: Your family is planning a four-day holiday in British Columbia this summer. Select the package that appeals to you more. Your mother has her heart set on the other package, so try to persuade her that yours is the better choice.

options.title: Tofino Beach Getaway
details: $2,650 CAD for a family of four, 4 days / 3 nights
Oceanfront cabin with a full kitchen
Includes a whale-watching tour and surf lessons
About 5 hours from Vancouver by ferry and car

options.title: Okanagan Lake Resort
details: $3,100 CAD for a family of four, 4 days / 3 nights
Hotel room with a breakfast buffet and an outdoor pool
Includes a winery tour and a boat rental for one afternoon

structure: Acknowledge why Mom likes the Okanagan, then state your choice.
Reason 1: value for money ($450 cheaper, kitchen saves on meals).
Reason 2: activities the whole family can share (whale watching, surfing vs. a winery tour).
Handle her objection (longer trip) and end with a warm, persuasive line.
modelAnswer: Mom, I totally understand why you like the Okanagan package. A lake, a pool and breakfast every morning sound really relaxing. But hear me out, because I think Tofino would make this a trip we'll remember for years. For one thing, it's $450 cheaper, and since the cabin has a full kitchen, we can cook some of our own meals instead of eating out three times a day. That alone could save us a few hundred dollars more. But it's not just about money. In Tofino, the activities are something all four of us can enjoy together. Whale watching is a once-in-a-lifetime experience, and Bao has been talking about trying surfing for ages. The winery tour, on the other hand, would be pretty boring for him. I know the trip is about an hour longer, but the ferry ride is actually part of the fun, and you could relax on the deck with a coffee. So, what do you say? Let's give the ocean a try this year.

commonMistakes: Dành quá nhiều thời gian mô tả cả hai gói du lịch; người nghe đã biết thông tin, hãy tập trung vào lý do thuyết phục.
Dùng 'travel' như danh từ đếm được ('a travel'); nói 'a trip' hoặc 'a holiday'.
Không có so sánh trực tiếp ('cheaper than', 'more… than', 'on the other hand'); Task 5 yêu cầu so sánh hai lựa chọn.
